name: tagwerk

description: Today's presence against the tagwerk day cap, as a meter in the bar.

barWidget.description: A meter running to today's presence, with the paid split solid inside it and the day cap notched on the track. Click opens the week table.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to run `tagwerk day --json`. The meter is 4px per hour, so anything under 15 minutes moves it less than a pixel.
